notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. Confirmed rig: Marshall ShredMaster (Ratatouille Dist approximation — both use similar op-amp/diode hard-clipping topology, ShredMaster Contour approximated by Filter parameter) into Marshall JCM800 2203 with Boss SD-1 (Stupor OD — confirmed key ingredient in Jonny's Bends-era tone). Since the JCM800 2203 is a specific confirmed amp (not just generic rig compensation), it's modeled as a Preamp-only block (Brit 2203, no cab/power amp) active across all three snapshots, per AGENTS.md's rule that preamp blocks are warranted when a real amp is confirmed for the part. DigiTech Whammy WH-1 confirmed for solo — Pitch Wham at +12 semitones (octave up) at 65% mix. Confirmed live: Jonny kicks on Whammy at 2:17 for squealing sustain of solo. Three snapshots: verse semi-clean, heavy riff, Whammy solo.

signal_chain.notes: Confirmed Boss SD-1 used on The Bends era. Pre-distortion boost and tone shaper — pushes Ratatouille and adds mid-forward character. ACTIVE in Snapshots 1 and 2. BYPASSED in Snapshot 3 — solo tone uses Ratatouille alone for clearer, more defined character.

ShredMaster approximation — both use op-amp gain stages with diode clipping. ShredMaster Contour control (mid scoop) approximated by Filter parameter. BYPASSED in Snapshot 1 (verse). ACTIVE in Snapshots 2 and 3. Note: Thom Yorke is a confirmed notable user of the RAT per YAML. Filter at 5.0 is neutral in S2; raised to 6.5 in S3 to give solo more sustaining character.

Approximates DigiTech Whammy WH-1 — CONFIRMED Jonny kicks Whammy on at 2:17 in live performance for squealing solo sustain, octave up setting. Switched from Poly Wham to Pitch Wham to free up DSP for the rest of the chain (Poly Wham's polyphonic tracking is one of the most DSP-heavy blocks in Helix, and stacked with the two drive blocks plus the preamp it was starving the downstream EQ/delay/reverb of DSP). Pitch Wham is mono-only, which matches the preset's playing notes — solo is single notes, not chords. Automatically assigned to EXP 1. Position 100 = full toe-down = constant octave up. Mix at 65% makes octave-up voice prominently audible. BYPASSED in Snapshots 1 and 2. ACTIVE in Snapshot 3 only. No Tracking or Auto EQ parameters on this model — those were specific to Poly Wham's polyphonic engine.

Confirmed amp for Jonny's Bends-era aggressive tones (per YAML notable_users). Preamp-only (no cab/power amp) — sits after the drive pedals and Pitch Wham, before the EQ/delay/reverb, mirroring pedals-into-amp-front-end signal path. ACTIVE across all three snapshots since this is the amp for the whole song, not a per-section coloration choice. S1 verse: moderate Drive for the semi-clean/mid-forward SD-1 tone. S2 heavy riff: Drive raised to match the stacked SD-1 into Ratatouille push. S3 whammy solo: Drive between the two, Sag raised slightly for looser compression under sustained bent notes. Input set to Low (the real 2203's -6dB reduced-sensitivity jack) since drive pedals precede the amp in every snapshot — pads the front end so the pedal-boosted signal doesn't over-drive the input stage into uncontrolled harshness, leaving the amp's own Drive knob to do the shaping.

S1 gentle and open — verse not heavily sculpted. S2 tightens high cut to control JCM800 brightness under heavy distortion. S3 raises mid frequency to 1.0kHz with wider Q — broader boost supports Pitch Wham octave-up voice. High Cut at 8kHz in S3 tames potential harshness of octave-up voice.

Confirmed Jonny used RE-201 since 1995, confirmed for The Bends era. Tempo-synced to 102 BPM. S1: eighth note = 294ms (original 320ms, 26ms off — using synced eighth). S2: sixteenth note = 147ms (original 160ms, 13ms off — synced). S3: eighth note = 294ms (original 280ms, 14ms off — synced). Treble rolled off in all snapshots to keep repeats dark.

Dynamic Hall chosen for Radiohead presets — has Low Cut and High Cut parameters for better frequency control than Ganymede. NOTE: Room Size should NOT be assigned to snapshots — it changes the algorithm and causes an audible bump. Set Room Size as a fixed value.

1_verse.description: Verse / semi-clean. SD-1 only — no Ratatouille. Pitch Wham bypassed. Brit 2203 preamp active at moderate Drive 4.0 for JCM800 front-end push. Gentle EQ, eighth note delay at 30% mix, moderate reverb. Not completely clean — controlled mid-forward OD character.

2_heavy_riff.description: Heavy riff. SD-1 boosting into Ratatouille — stacked ShredMaster approximation, both pushing the Brit 2203 preamp (Drive 6.5) hard. Pitch Wham bypassed. Very short sixteenth note delay (147ms) at 12% mix. Very dry reverb (0.6 sec, 10% mix). Maximum punch.

3_whammy_solo.description: Whammy solo. SD-1 bypassed — Ratatouille alone at Gain 7.0, Filter 6.5, into Brit 2203 preamp (Drive 5.5, Sag 5 for looser sustain). Pitch Wham active — Position 100, Toe Pitch +12, Mix 65%. Octave-up voice prominent. EQ mid at 1.0kHz wider Q. Eighth note delay at 35% mix. High Cut at 8kHz to tame octave harshness.

playing_notes.pickup_notes: Bridge pickup throughout all three snapshots
playing_notes.technique: Verse requires firm deliberate picking — after recording The Bends Jonny developed arm pain requiring a brace, which tells you how hard he was playing. Full commitment to downstrokes on the riff.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Snapshot 1 for verse sections. Snapshot 2 for heavy riff sections. Snapshot 3 at exactly 2:17 in the live arrangement when Whammy engages — switch at this moment for maximum dramatic effect.
playing_notes.whammy_technique: Play solo as single notes only — Pitch Wham is mono-only (no polyphonic tracking). Hold notes and let Whammy octave-up and Cosmos Echo sustain and bloom. Space and sustain are the tools — resist playing busily.
playing_notes.pre_chorus_technique: Verse sections (Snapshot 1) are not completely clean — there is a controlled mid-forward OD. Match this by picking with moderate force rather than trying to play softly into a clean tone.
